about: Jindal Supreme (India) Limited manufactures mild steel (MS) black pipes and tubes, galvanised pipes, metal beam crash barriers and GI tubular poles from a single plant in Hisar, Haryana. It sells to infrastructure contractors, industrial buyers and 53 dealers, mainly in northern India. Revenue from operations was Rs 675.39 crore in FY26, all domestic.

promoters.background: Family-run business started in 1974 by the late Madan Lal Jindal; Abhishek Jindal (MD) has been with the company since 2007. The offer-for-sale seller is promoter group entity VVJ Enterprise Pvt Ltd.

concentration.note: FY26 top 10 customers 20.32% of revenue (top customer 5.82%); Q1FY27 top 10 24.09%. Top 10 suppliers were 76.23% of FY26 purchases.

litigation_note: Against the company: 2 tax proceedings (about Rs 0.07 lakh quantified) plus 3 GST DRC-01C intimations alleging excess input tax credit of Rs 564 lakh (Rs 5.64 crore), with no demand or show cause notice issued. Company-filed matters: 1 civil and 2 criminal cases. No contingent liabilities reported.
strengths: Operating since 1974 with a founder-family management team and a long track record in MS black and galvanised pipes.
Product range widened into metal beam crash barriers (FY25) and GI tubular poles (FY26), tapping highway and street-lighting demand.
Return on equity of 26.28% and ROCE of 16.78% in FY26, with EBITDA margin up from 3.27% in FY24 to 6.16% in FY26.
Customer base is fairly spread out: the largest customer was 5.82% and the top 10 were 20.32% of FY26 revenue.
Dealer network grew from 34 to 53 over FY24 to FY26, and dealers brought in 31.82% of FY26 revenue.
The company reports no contingent liabilities, and all revenue is domestic.
Rs 71 crore of the fresh issue goes to repaying debt, which should cut interest costs; FY26 debt/equity was 1.24.

risks.title: Single plant in Hisar
risks.detail: All manufacturing is at one facility in Hisar, Haryana. A shutdown or local disruption would hit the whole business. Utilisation fell from 75.00% in FY24 to 61.66% in FY26.

risks.title: High debt and heavy working capital need
risks.detail: Borrowings were Rs 119.87 crore in FY26 against net worth of Rs 96.82 crore (debt/equity 1.24). Operating cash flow turned negative at -Rs 5.69 crore in FY26.

risks.title: Thin margins and volatile profit
risks.detail: PAT margin was 3.33% in FY26 and PAT fell from Rs 24.27 crore in FY25 to Rs 22.53 crore in FY26. Other income was Rs 18.34 crore in FY25, about 57% of that year's pre-tax profit.

risks.title: Dependence on a few raw material suppliers
risks.detail: Top 10 suppliers supplied 76.23% of FY26 purchases (70.92% in FY25, 75.73% in FY24). Any delay or shortage would hit output.

risks.title: Related-party dealings
risks.detail: Purchases from promoter group entity VVJ Enterprise were Rs 37.36 crore in FY25 and Rs 40.36 crore in FY24. The plant land is leased from promoters, and the promoter had lent Rs 6.97 crore (unsecured) as of Jun-26.

risks.title: Plant land is leased from promoters
risks.detail: Part of the plant land is held on leave-and-license from Abhishek Jindal and Janak Raj Jindal until December 2052. Termination or non-renewal on poor terms could force the company to vacate.

risks.title: Promoter group is selling and valuation is not cheap versus earnings
risks.detail: Promoter group entity VVJ Enterprise is selling 26.87 lakh shares worth Rs 24.99 crore. P/E at the cap price is 16.64 on FY26 EPS; the three listed peers trade at 22.31 to 65.55.

risks.title: GST and tax notices
risks.detail: Three GST DRC-01C intimations allege excess input tax credit of Rs 5.64 crore. No show cause notice or demand has been issued yet.

notes: Standalone Ind AS restated financials (no subsidiaries mentioned); source figures in lakhs converted to Rs crore. Q1FY27 stub (Jun-26: revenue Rs 190.94 crore, PAT Rs 8.28 crore) ignored in arrays. EBITDA, EBITDA margin, ROCE, ROE and debt/equity are as reported in the company's KPI table; PAT margin is on total income as reported. Reserves for Mar-26 are lower because of the Nov-2025 20:1 bonus issue. Borrowings are non-current plus current from the balance sheet. Cash_and_bank is cash and cash equivalents only (bank balances other than cash shown nil/unclear). Current ratio not extractable (current liabilities garbled). Peer revenue is FY26 revenue from operations. Prospectus price band Rs 88-93.
